question: What bodily and perceptual benefits result from this wheel’s practice?
premises: The practice affects signs of aging.
Wrinkles and grey hair are removed.
The practice also grants seeing from very far away.
inference: This practice brings destruction of wrinkles and grey hair and likewise vision from very far away.
plain_english: It brings the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair, and likewise the power to see from very far away.
